objective: Turn Local Knowledge Terminal's multilingual, source-grounded graph into a useful read-only MCP bridge first, then consider an Amazon hackathon entry without counting a registration or prize possibility as revenue.

program.name: Build, Ship, Shape: Amazon Developer Hackathon
program.payment_boundary: Prizes are competitive. Registration, joining, submission, finalist status, judging, or an announced award is not received revenue.

project.name: LKT Knowledge Bridge
project.standalone_value: Let an MCP-capable agent query an allow-listed local multilingual knowledge graph and trace every returned claim back to its exact source unit, locator, excerpt, and hash.
selected_scope: A separate read-only MCP process with loopback as the default
One bounded multilingual knowledge query tool
One exact claim or evidence trace tool
A metadata-only collections and readiness resource
No request-time model call, corpus mutation, file upload, arbitrary SQL, or shell execution
project.privacy_boundary: The corpus and indexes remain local. When a remote MCP client invokes a tool, its query and the bounded returned facts leave the device; the feature is opt-in and is not private end to end.
project.why_not_lazytunnel: Publishing device or tunnel control through a voice-facing MCP surface would materially enlarge LazyTunnel's security boundary and require a multi-week OAuth and capability architecture. LKT can deliver standalone value through read-only provenance queries in days.

registration.gate: An organization entry requires an eligible adult human representative authorized to bind LazyingArt LLC. Account creation accepts Devpost terms; joining accepts participation and data-consent obligations; submission adds organization authority, ownership, licensing, publicity, indemnity, and eligibility representations.
required_before_join: A written company authorization naming the human representative
Verified representative adulthood and residence eligibility
Review of Devpost terms and the current challenge rules
required_before_submission: Public repository and qualifying open-source license
Significant post-2026-08-31 implementation identified in the demo
Public under-three-minute YouTube or Vimeo demonstration
Reviewed project ownership and third-party rights
Exact organization, country, track, contributor, and form answers
Acceptance of the submission-specific warranties and publicity terms
registration.policy: Do not invent the representative, sign company authority, or accept submission warranties on the user's behalf. Product development may continue independently because it has value outside the competition.
